description: S3 — route count 10 -> 50 -> 100 -> 250 -> 500 -> 1000 at a low per-route rate (10 ev/s/route), incremental (routes of earlier cases stay deployed). Records per-route deploy->running latency, worker goroutines/RSS/CPU, producer clients, Kafka lag and e2e latency per step. The worker needs ROUTER_WORKER_CAPACITY >= 1000 (default 100): ROUTER_WORKER_CAPACITY=1200 deploy/dev/run.sh restart worker. Scheduler cycle and PG connections are read from the api/worker logs and pg_stat_activity (see README) — not sampled by the runner.
